filling: Isabella, everything looks so busy! Are you getting all set for the Valentine's Day party? It looks like you have a lot going on!
It is! We are putting so much love into it. I'm just making sure everything is perfect for our guests on the 14th. You know how much I love making Hobbs Cafe a welcoming place for everyone!
It really shows! I've been thinking about it, and I'd really love to come to the party on the 14th, even with my physics studying right now. It sounds like it's going to be so special!
That would make me so happy, Maria! We'd love to have you. Don't worry about your studies; take a break and come relax with us! We've got some lovely things planned for the evening.
That's so sweet of you to say! I'm really looking forward to it. I'll make sure my studying doesn't get in the way!
That's all wonderful to hear! It means a lot to me. Maybe we can catch up properly on the day, and you can see all the festive touches we've put together!
I really hope I can manage my schedule to make it! I'm excited to see what you have planned for the 14th!

I'll be putting the finishing touches on some special touches around the cafe today. When you're free, maybe swing by later this afternoon? Even a quick peek at the preparations might make your day a little brighter! 😊
That sounds lovely! I might swing by later this afternoon if I get a break from physics. Thanks for the invite, Isabella! Looking forward to the 14th!

filling: Hi Isabella! You seem really busy with all the Valentine's Day prep. How's it going?

It's keeping me on my toes, but it's going well! I'm so excited for the party. I'm trying to make Hobbs Cafe extra special for all our customers on February 14th. How about you? Still deep in physics?
Yeah, still grinding through some physics problems! It's intense, but I love diving into new ideas. How are you managing all the decorating and planning? Anything exciting planned for the party?

Well, I'm planning a little Valentine's Day celebration from 5 to 7 PM on the 14th! I'm decorating, making sure the atmosphere is cozy, and planning some special touches to make everyone feel extra loved. It's going to be fun! Do you think you'll be stopping by?
That sounds lovely! I might swing by to check out the atmosphere before or after class. I'm so excited for a cozy, special vibe at Hobbs Cafe! I'm sure it'll be a huge hit.
I really hope so! It would be great to see you there and share the festive spirit. Let me know if you decide to come! In the meantime, keep up the great work with your physics!
